as_told.title: McMoneagle remote views Mars pyramids, JPL contacts send photos

plain: In 1984, according to the philosopher Jason Jorjani, a remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle, someone said to describe distant places using only his mind, was tasked by the CIA at the Monroe Institute, a Virginia centre for consciousness research, to view Mars a million years ago. McMoneagle tells it himself and says he saw pyramids and dying people, "just really big people," about 12 feet tall, though he gives no date or CIA link. Michels repeats it on several episodes, adding that the full session transcript has been declassified and that contacts at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory sent McMoneagle photos, which would suggest Mars once held human-like life.
